features.title: Core Project Infrastructure
acceptance: FastAPI backend with modular structure (app/main.py, api/, services/, models/, core/)
Dockerfiles for backend with non-root users
compose.yaml (backend + Keycloak) with persistent volumes, 127.0.0.1 ports
pytest backend tests (>=12 meaningful tests)
CI workflow running backend tests and backend Docker build
portfolio.json at root with required schema
pyproject.toml project metadata

features.title: Natural Language to IaC Generation Workflow
acceptance: POST /api/generate accepting description, provider, target, use_llm
Returns Terraform/CloudFormation/ARM template with validation summary and cost estimate, persisted with pagination/filtering
Export/download via template field; cost estimation displayed alongside

features.title: IaC Validation & Linting Workflow
acceptance: POST /api/validate for Terraform/CloudFormation/ARM
Returns syntax errors, best-practice warnings, missing required fields

features.title: Cost Estimation Workflow
acceptance: POST /api/estimate from template or component list
Returns monthly cost breakdown by resource and region

features.title: Multi-Provider LLM Adapters
acceptance: OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama adapters in services/llm.py
Configurable via LLM_PROVIDER, LLM_MODEL, LLM_BASE_URL
Deterministic offline core works without LLM key
Keys only server-side, bounded timeouts, redacted errors

features.title: Authentication, RBAC and SAML Brokering
acceptance: local JWT login with HttpOnly cookie + CSRF endpoint
viewer/operator/admin roles enforced on data endpoints
role denial and unauthenticated rejection tests
Keycloak OIDC + SAML identity brokering (planned)

features.title: React + TypeScript Vite Dashboard
acceptance: Typed API client derived from backend routes
Generate form with description, provider, target, use_llm
Template display with syntax highlighting
Cost estimation panel
Validation panel
Dashboard with history list (pagination, filtering)
Loading/error/empty states
Create/import/search/detail/export workflows
vitest frontend tests (>=3)
